determinism.mechanism: SurfacePoints are randomly generated per agent initialization when unauthored; submerged-point ratio directly scales vertical buoyant force

instability.criterion: non-finite acceleration immediately, or combined tilt greater than 60 degrees for 1.0 continuous simulation second
instability.limitation: translational acceleration can contaminate tilt; one-second hold rejects brief transients

grounding_and_object_collision.reason: native CollisionSensor discards OtherActor and FHitResult and exports only a boolean

allocation_failure.source: requested versus wrapper-applied native thruster force
allocation_failure.criterion: non-finite command immediately, or relative residual greater than 20% for 1.0 continuous simulation second
allocation_failure.limitation: command-path integrity and saturation only; HoloOcean exposes no achieved-force feedback
